findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: slopscore_check_website, tells_check_writing, doorman_check_ai_bot_access, mend_repair_json, mend_query_json · Private data: tokendiet_count_tokens, runsheet_create_schedule, swatch_make_scale, meridian_convert_time, mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json · Public sink: tokendiet_count_tokens, tells_check_writing, runsheet_create_schedule, halves_settle_up, halves_create_group_link, meridian_convert_time, mend_query_json · Destructive: aitab_total_ai_subscriptions, runsheet_create_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: slopscore_check_website, tells_check_writing, doorman_check_ai_bot_access, mend_repair_json, mend_query_json · Private data: tokendiet_count_tokens, runsheet_create_schedule, swatch_make_scale, meridian_convert_time, mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json · Public sink: tokendiet_count_tokens, tells_check_writing, runsheet_create_schedule, halves_settle_up, halves_create_group_link, meridian_convert_time, mend_query_json · Destructive: aitab_total_ai_subscriptions, runsheet_create_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
